title: getTemplateGraph request
description: GET /v1/templates/{templateId}/graph - request. Snapshot of a template's version DAG from a templateSeq, to close a sequence gap or bootstrap a cell replica (very low frequency). Fallback in the caller: template marked GRAPH_STALE.
$comment: Source: DISENO S1 (d) GraphSnapshotQuery / GraphController, (e), AP-R4 (template_id, seq); DISENO 4.5 (f), 4.6; DISENO 4.8 SX-02; ADR-020 SX-02; ADR-018. Audience: INTERNAL service-to-service - SX-02 callee. Residency: GLOBAL (home region); TEMPLATE_PUBLIC metadata, replicable to every region. Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: sinceSeq + cursor + limit <= N_pagemax (DISENO 3.1 (e), 3.8.5).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).

queryParams.description: Query parameters (exactly as documented; unknown parameters are rejected with 400).

sinceSeq.description: Return nodes with templateSeq > sinceSeq (0 = full graph for a cell bootstrap).
